name: Pony Diffusion V6 XL (SDXL)
notes: One checkpoint holds the model, both text encoders (CLIP-L + CLIP-G) and the VAE, about 6.5 GB in fp16. Fits an 8 GB card. No official fp8 / int8 / GGUF versions; every finetune of this family is the same size and speed.
Needs its score tags (score_9, score_8_up, ...) and clip skip 2. About 25 steps at cfg 6-7.
5090 times measured with cyberrealisticPony v17 (a Pony finetune, same architecture). The download is a community mirror of the CivitAI release.

variants.note: full checkpoint incl. text encoders and VAE

source: Hugging Face tree API sizes (LyliaEngine/Pony_Diffusion_V6_XL), measured 2026-09-30

quality.method: single format (fp16 checkpoint): the reference itself

benchmarks.workflow: CheckpointLoaderSimple, 1024 / 1408 square, cfg 6, euler/normal; step_s = slope of two step counts (a fast card's progress reporting adds a fixed ~0.1 s per step that this removes)

machine.note: 64 GB RAM, PCIe Gen5 x8, no SageAttention
